Display preferences persist only the original versioned booleans
Storage failure shows a visible failure and does not claim preference success

Unknown preference schema falls back safely and never turns a stored path into authority

Exported SQLite passes actual integrity and archived-message readback

Non-backup selection shows an actionable failure instead of a success banner
A secondary renderer cannot invoke either local backup action
Exhausted controlled chooser shows bounded human feedback and releases local ownership
All six real setting pages and default-model portals fit light/dark native viewports with readable text and real Escape focus restoration

Real official DeepSeek reply completes through the preserved formal composer after unified settings

Real subsequent ordinary task and stop preserve the teacher rename to the default label
Bound conversation directory remains locked after real native history exists
U2 history manager renames and navigation search filters the real conversation while retaining original native message bytes
Real archive confirmation traps focus and Escape cancels without mutation across native light/dark viewports
Actual live conversation archive cancellation preserves history and confirmation creates a fresh conversation through the U2 history manager
Archived real selected-skill message uses the same public overlay without editing native history
Actual archived live reply and teacher title remain readable after cold restart with unchanged native bytes and zero startup tool replay
Source teacher fixtures remain byte-identical and renderer has no runtime exceptions

boundaries: Actual formal Electron + owned fresh SQLite/profile, live official DeepSeek catalogue and chat, actual local backup/readback; synthetic teacher files only.
Native chooser returns controlled in main; browser storage failure injected only for the owned profile.
Archive fixtures created via existing typed APIs; archive creation UI and OS chooser clicking not claimed.
No full Codex pixel-match, VPN-off or installer proof.
Recovery is a filesystem restoration drill to a new owned root; production has no restore UI/IPC. Application stays light under either OS color preference.

recovery.kind: verified backup filesystem restore into new isolated root
